title: Tool Disambiguation - Similar Functions
query: Get the customer's order history for the last 3 months

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get a single order by ID

tools.name: get_order_history
tools.description: Get all orders for a customer

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return

explanation: This is about DISAMBIGUATION - choosing the RIGHT tool among similar options. We have get_order (single order), get_order_history (multiple orders for a customer), and search_orders (keyword search). The query asks for 'order history for the last 3 months' which matches get_order_history. We can use 'customer_id' default (current user) and specify start_date. search_orders would work but is less specific.
learning_points: Read ALL function descriptions carefully before choosing
Choose the most specific function that matches the intent
Consider defaults: customer_id defaults to current user
More specific functions are usually better than generic search

wrong_answers.why_wrong: get_order retrieves ONE order, not history of multiple orders
search_orders is for keyword search, get_order_history is more specific for this use case

hints: User wants HISTORY (multiple orders), not a single order
get_order_history is designed specifically for this
customer_id parameter defaults to current user
Provide start_date to filter by time range
